artifact_reviews.tenant_isolation.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM artifacts a
  WHERE ((a.id = artifact_reviews.artifact_id) AND (a.tenant_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid))))
artifact_reviews.tenant_isolation.with_check:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM artifacts a
  WHERE ((a.id = artifact_reviews.artifact_id) AND (a.tenant_id = (NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid))))

artifact_tags.system_published_read.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM artifacts a
  WHERE ((a.id = artifact_tags.artifact_id) AND (a.tenant_id = '0195f48b-d000-7000-8000-000000000001'::uuid) AND ((a.visibility)::text = 'tenant'::text) AND (a.publish_status = 'published'::text) AND ((NULLIF(current_setting('app.current_tenant'::text, true), ''::text))::uuid = ANY (ARRAY['0195f48b-d000-7000-8000-000000000001'::uuid, '0195f48b-d000-7000-8000-000000000002'::uuid, '0195f48b-d000-7000-8000-000000000003'::uuid, '0195f48b-d000-7000-8000-000000000004'::uuid, '0195f48b-d000-7000-8000-000000000005'::uuid, '019de842-c92a-7e37-8fdd-eb0d8c5396f9'::uuid])))))
